material.$description: Glass and light only on things that float above the page, and it should look natural. Page controls stay flat (no blur). 'glass-on-art' is a control floating over a prototype: a warm near-black tint with a soft blur, no colored glow. Based on After Graduation's dark glass, warmed.

blur.$description: Page controls are flat, not glass.

saturate.$description: Stays 1: this one value also applies to flat page controls (chips, secondary buttons, the segmented lens), and glass is only for floating layers.

blur-on-art.$description: Glass on floating layers: a 20px blur behind it.

blur-on-art-selected.$description: Same blur when chosen; the chosen state is a lighter surface, not more frost.

refraction-band.$description: How far in from the edge the glass bends what is behind it. Wide and gentle.

refraction-max.$description: The most a line behind the glass shifts at the edge. Small, so the bend reads as natural.

glass.$description: Fill for page controls: a faint cream tint, not glass, so controls sit on the page and on panels alike.

glass-strong.$description: Page control on hover, and the chosen segment: one surface step lighter (near-black 700), no color fill. Matches the Reduce transparency fallback (surface.raised).

glass-on-art.$description: Floating glass: near-black 800 at 72% over a 20px blur.

glass-on-art-selected.$description: The chosen floating tool: near-black 700, one step lighter, no color fill. Cream text on it passes (8.2:1 on solid near-black 700).

glass.$description: A faint cream line along the top edge, as if lit from above.

rim.$description: The lit edge of floating glass: a 1px cream line at about 12%, brightest toward the shared light (top right), never colored.

faint.$description: The rim where it faces away from the light: a faint line, so the glass edge never disappears.

strength.$description: How bright the rim gets where it faces the light (1 is the rim color at full strength).

glint.$description: The faint glint on the far corner, where light leaves the glass.

spread-x.$description: How far the lit part of the rim reaches across the glass.

highlight.$description: Inner highlight along the edge that faces the light.

shade.$description: Inner shade along the edge facing away from the light.

cast.$description: Shadow the glass casts, falling away from the light.

cast-distance.$description: How far the shadow falls from the glass, away from the light.

cast-blur.$description: How soft the cast shadow is.

contact.$description: The tight shadow right under the glass's edge.

lens.$description: Lens glass, for artwork the design system controls. The toolkit has no artwork yet, so nothing uses these; they keep Fireside's set the same as every theme's, in its own colors.

body.$description: The glass's body: cream 100 at this strength over the art.

tint.$description: A faint rust tint at this strength (rust 300), so the glass reads as glass, not a hole.

rim-width.$description: The lit rim along the glass's edge.

rim-lit.$description: The rim where it faces the light, at its brightest.

rim-faint.$description: The rim everywhere else, so the edge never disappears.

highlight.$description: The soft band of light just inside the edge that faces the light.

shadow-color.$description: The shadow the glass casts away from the light (the alpha is its strength).

shadow-distance.$description: How far the shadow falls away from the light.

bend.$description: How strongly the edge bends the art (1 is a true rounded bevel).

edge-depth.$description: How far in from the edge the glass curves and bends the art. Never more than 95% of half the glass's height; the middle stays clear.

color-split.$description: A faint color split where the art bends, like real glass.

press-swell.$description: How much the glass swells when pressed, before it settles back.

press-duration.$description: How long the press swell takes to settle back to rest.

tilt-reach.$description: How far tilting a phone moves the light, at most. The light eases back when the phone is still.
